message: PctWidget (libs/components/widget/src/widget.ts) keeps its widget inside the template and declares no ariaLabel / ariaLabelledby
$reason: Two decorated classes named `PctWidgetBase`, which TypeScript compiles in two files: `base.ts`, which `widget.ts` imports, without the naming inputs, and `other.ts` with both. Keyed by name, the merge took the class read last, handed `PctWidget` inputs no build gives it and passed an unnamed widget. Through the import, `PctWidget` has the base it extends and no name, and point 3 refuses it.
